scripts.check: npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 lint && npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 validate && npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 inspect --samples 18
scripts.render:shorts:final: npm run render:shorts && npm run normalize:shorts
scripts.render:final: npm run render && npm run normalize
scripts.normalize: ffmpeg -y -i renders/grantpipe-product-tour-landscape.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -b:v 10M -minrate 10M -maxrate 10M -bufsize 10M -x264-params nal-hrd=cbr:filler=1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k renders/grantpipe-product-tour-landscape-normalized.mp4 && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('renders/grantpipe-product-tour-landscape-normalized.mp4','renders/grantpipe-product-tour-landscape.mp4')"
scripts.normalize:shorts: ffmpeg -y -i renders/grantpipe-product-tour-shorts-portrait.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -b:v 9M -minrate 9M -maxrate 9M -bufsize 9M -x264-params nal-hrd=cbr:filler=1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k renders/grantpipe-product-tour-shorts-portrait-normalized.mp4 && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('renders/grantpipe-product-tour-shorts-portrait-normalized.mp4','renders/grantpipe-product-tour-shorts-portrait.mp4')"
